prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: CACE school vocabulary level N3 SUBJECT PLUS ACTION. ONE clear friendly flat 2D educational drawing with clean outlines and readable shapes. The animal may act anthropomorphically but must retain its species features. No 3D rendering. Exact approved Catalan construction: CABRA + TELEFONAR (Cabra telefonant). Show ONE clearly recognizable subject visibly performing ONLY the named action, rather than just posing. Talking on one plain telephone held clearly to ear; no screen content or text.  Pure white seamless background. Minimal necessary context and only the essential prop for the action; no unrelated objects and no second person or animal. Entire subject and necessary props fully inside frame with ample white margin on ALL sides (at least 12 percent, subject occupying only the central 65 percent of frame). For jumping or flying show the feet off the ground; for swimming use a small clearly bounded patch of water with body readable. No action words or symbolic labels. No text, letters, numerals, logos, brands, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermarks, including on clothing, books and screens. Books and writing/drawing supports can be blank; use at most simple non-symbolic marks. No collage or multiple panels. Correct natural anatomy, no extra limbs. School-friendly, no violence, horror or frightening expression. Vary human appearance naturally across the series; this subject's skin tone should be light. Photo children fully and ordinarily clothed. One image only; clearly teach the named subject and action. CRITICAL ANATOMY: goat has EXACTLY FOUR LIMBS TOTAL. Draw it sitting on its haunches, two rear hooves visible forward; one front hoof rests on its belly and the other front hoof holds telephone receiver at ear. Do NOT draw four standing legs plus an extra arm. Entire goat including horns, all four limbs and tail within margins.
